parts.text: Use run_command once with command "sleep 30; printf 'HINT-JOB-DONE\n'" and ai_callback_delay 45. After it returns, follow any hint I send and give a concise final answer. Do not call other tools.
In your final answer include exactly HINT-ACCEPTED-FIVE and briefly mention the command output.
Answer helpfully and concisely. Retain the conversation's details.
